name: core-modeling
description: Coverage-guided point-and-click QA for core Zoo Design Studio modeling workflows.

scenarios.title: Rectangle sketch and extrusion control
scenarios.hypothesis: A fresh Top-plane rectangle can be selected and extruded into exactly one body.

scenarios.title: Closed line profile and knife extrusion
scenarios.hypothesis: A multi-segment closed profile produces one selectable region and a 4 mm knife solid.

scenarios.title: Extrusion undo and redo regeneration
scenarios.hypothesis: Undo removes the submitted extrusion and Body 1; redo restores both code and geometry.

scenarios.title: Editor rewrite followed by point-and-click sketch
scenarios.hypothesis: Rewriting a valid settings-only program preserves the engine-side sketch object for subsequent point-and-click segments.

scenarios.title: Symmetric point-and-click extrusion
scenarios.hypothesis: A point-and-click rectangle can be previewed and submitted as an 8 mm symmetric extrusion with one resulting body.

scenarios.title: Negative point-and-click extrusion
scenarios.hypothesis: A negative extrusion length reverses the preview and final geometry without validation or selection-state errors.

scenarios.title: Fillet application and feature-tree edit
scenarios.hypothesis: A selected extrusion edge can receive a 1 mm fillet, then regenerate after its feature-tree radius is edited to 0.5 mm.

scenarios.title: Chamfer application and feature-tree edit
scenarios.hypothesis: A selected extrusion edge can receive a 1 mm chamfer, then regenerate after its feature-tree length is edited to 0.5 mm.

scenarios.title: Four-hole mounting plate with upstream countersink edit
scenarios.hypothesis: Four GUI-created blind holes remain valid when the first upstream hole is edited into a countersink, preserving all downstream features and one body.

scenarios.title: Sketch edit and solid regeneration
scenarios.hypothesis: Moving a rectangle vertex after extrusion regenerates the body without stale regions or selections.

scenarios.title: Multi-body subtraction history and reload
scenarios.hypothesis: Subtracting one selected solid from another reduces six bodies to five, undo restores both inputs, redo restores the boolean result, and reload preserves its KCL, geometry, body count, and Feature Tree state.

scenarios.title: Shell regeneration with downstream linear pattern
scenarios.hypothesis: Resubmitting an upstream Shell preserves its extrusion input, the downstream linear pattern, valid KCL, and rendered bodies.

scenarios.title: Upstream linear-pattern edit with downstream pattern
scenarios.hypothesis: Editing the first of two chained linear patterns preserves extrude001 -> pattern001 -> pattern002, valid KCL, and the regenerated body grid.

scenarios.title: Upstream circular-pattern edit with downstream linear pattern
scenarios.hypothesis: Editing a circular pattern that feeds a linear pattern preserves extrude001 -> pattern001 -> pattern002, valid KCL, and the regenerated body grid.

scenarios.title: Upstream Translate edit with downstream linear pattern
scenarios.hypothesis: Editing a translation that feeds a linear pattern preserves its extrusion input, downstream pattern, valid KCL, and regenerated bodies.

scenarios.title: Settings route normalization after reload
scenarios.hypothesis: Reloading a file route leaves the Settings status-bar link with one path separator, opens project settings, and returns to the same file without router warnings.

scenarios.title: Pending extrusion across modeling connection recovery
scenarios.hypothesis: A recoverable modeling connection interruption preserves a reviewed extrusion and submits it exactly once.

scenarios.title: Offset profile revolve creation and angle edit
scenarios.hypothesis: An offset rectangle can be revolved 360 degrees around the X axis, then edited to 180 degrees while preserving one valid body.

scenarios.title: Two-region Loft creation and V-degree edit
scenarios.hypothesis: Two segmented circle regions on offset planes can be lofted into one solid, then regenerated after a Feature Tree V-degree edit.

scenarios.title: Helix Sweep creation and sectional edit
scenarios.hypothesis: A circular region can be swept along a helix path into one body, then regenerated after enabling sectional mode from the Feature Tree.
